name: Assassin Ann
source:
Four young people have a dream of standing on stage in America, the homeland of dance. They form a dance team called J-Rap, and work hard every day at their lessons. One of these members is Kobori Kensuke, a genius hacker.

One day Kensuke learns that their dance coach, Ann Hayworth, is an assassin for the mysterious organization “Gopher”. Ann asks him to lend his expertise to the organization, but he declines due to his strong sense of justice. However he keeps getting caught up in the fight between “Gopher” and the immergant religion “Tsuneyodakai”.

And danger is also fast approaching the members of J-Rap.

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8985]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
四名年轻人梦想着登上舞蹈发源地美国的舞台。他们组成名为J-Rap的舞团，每天刻苦训练。其中一名成员小堀健介是一位天才黑客。

一天，健介得知他们的舞蹈教练安·平沃斯其实是神秘组织“Gopher”的杀手。安请他利用专业技术协助组织，但正义感强烈的他拒绝了。然而，他仍不断被卷入“Gopher”与新兴宗教“常依田会”的争斗。

危险也正迅速逼近J-Rap的其他成员。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8985]Getchu.com[/url]简介]
